# Locality Guide: Naples, Ontario County, New York (1845–1925)

## Jurisdictional Context

Naples (Town, organized 1789) and Naples Village (incorporated 1894) are in **Ontario County**, New York. The county was organized 27 January 1789 from Montgomery County, with Canandaigua as its seat. Boundaries remained stable throughout the target period. Naples sits in the southwestern corner of Ontario County, bordering Steuben and Yates counties.

## Death Records

| Record Type | Date Range | Access | FamilySearch Collection |
|-------------|-----------|--------|------------------------|
| NY State Death Index | 1880–1956 | Indexed + images | [2803479](https://www.familysearch.org/search/collection/2803479) |
| NY Deaths and Burials | 1795–1952 | Indexed | [1680846](https://www.familysearch.org/search/collection/1680846) |
| NY Church and Civil Deaths | 1797–1963 | Indexed | [2373798](https://www.familysearch.org/search/collection/2373798) |

**Key caveat:** Statewide death registration began 1880 and was generally complied with by 1890. For deaths before ca. 1890, expect gaps; rely on newspaper notices, church records, and cemetery transcriptions as substitutes.

### Death Substitutes (pre-1880 / compliance gap)
- **Ontario County Journal** death notices, 1873–1910: free transcriptions at ontario.nygenweb.net
- **Ontario Repository & Messenger** death notices, 1868–1873: free at NYGenWeb
- Church records (see below)
- Cemetery records (see below)

## Burial / Cemetery Records

| Resource | Notes |
|----------|-------|
| Find A Grave | Searchable; a memorial for Johann Frederich Widmer already exists (SLWP-HCJ) |
| BillionGraves | Searchable by name and Ontario County |
| Interment.net | Ontario County section |
| NY Cemetery Abstracts 1800–1965 | FamilySearch col. 2552111 — indexed |
| Rose Ridge Cemetery, Naples NY | Family members (George, Fred E., Howard Widmer) buried here — high probability for Johann |
| NYGenWeb Cemeteries | ontario.nygenweb.net/cemeteries.htm |

## Census Records

**Federal censuses** available for this period (all indexed on FamilySearch): 1860, 1870, 1880, 1900, 1910, 1920.

**New York State censuses** (fill federal gaps, often include birthplace/parents' birthplace):

| Year | FamilySearch Collection |
|------|------------------------|
| 1855 | 1937366 |
| 1865 | 1491284 |
| 1875 | 1918735 |
| 1892 | 1529100 |
| 1905 | 1463113 |
| 1915 | 1937454 |
| 1925 | 1937489 |

All state census years listed above are fully indexed on FamilySearch. The **Ontario County Records and Archives Center** (raims.com) also has completed census name indexes through 1892, searchable by town.

## Church Records

- **NY Church Records, 1660–1954** (FamilySearch col. 2787817) — 127,105 indexed records
- **Marriage and Funeral Records of Universalist Church, 1850s–1880s** — free at ontario.nygenweb.net
- **Rev. O.P. Alderman Marriages (Naples & Phelps), 1846–1888** — NYGenWeb
- **Cornell University Study Center for Early Religious Life in Western New York** holds Ontario County church records; online guide at rmc.library.cornell.edu

For a Swiss Reformed or Lutheran immigrant, check Universalist, Reformed, and Lutheran churches in Naples township.

## Probate Records

- **NY Probate Records, 1629–1971** (FamilySearch col. 1920234) — ~14 million images, browse-only (0% indexed). Ontario County Surrogate Court records from 1789. Probate petitions (required from 1830) typically state death date and list heirs.
- **NY Wills and Probate Records, 1659–1999** at Ancestry — indexed + images ($)

## Naturalization Records (Swiss immigrant)

- **NY County Naturalization Records, 1791–1980** (col. 1999177) — 3.3M indexed records — search Ontario County
- **NY Naturalization Index (Soundex), 1792–1906** (col. 2043782) — indexed + images
- **NY Western District Naturalization Index, 1907–1966** (col. 1854307) — indexed + images

Naturalization papers often give exact birthplace and date/port of immigration — high value for establishing birth information.

## Newspapers & Obituaries

- Ontario County Journal, Canandaigua: death notices 1873–1910 (free, ontario.nygenweb.net/records.htm)
- Ontario Repository & Messenger: death/marriage notices 1841–1873 (free, NYGenWeb)
- Ontario County Chronicle: notices 1900–1907 (free, NYGenWeb)
- NY Obituary Resources: genealogybuff.com/ny/

## External Repositories

- **Ontario County Dept. of Records, Archives and Information Management Services (RAIMS)**: raims.com — free online death index for Canandaigua 1882–1909; census indexes through 1892
- **New York State Department of Health**: genealogy.health.ny.gov — certified death certificates from 1880 for a fee
- **New York State Archives**: nysarchives.nysed.gov — pre-1880 vital records and court records

## Research Priority for This Project

1. **Find A Grave entry already in sources (SLWP-HCJ)** — extract it first; likely gives death date, burial place, and cemetery name.
2. **NY State Death Index, 1880–1956** (col. 2803479) — search for death registration; will give exact date, place, and often informant.
3. **NY State Census 1915/1925** — if Johann survived past 1910 (last census appearance), these will confirm continued residence or flag departure.
4. **Rose Ridge Cemetery, Naples** — multiple Widmer children buried there; Johann almost certainly buried here too.
5. **Ontario County Journal obituaries/death notices** (1873–1910) — free substitute if death predates 1880 or record is unregistered.
6. **Naturalization records** — for exact Swiss birthplace and immigration date.

## Locality Guide — Hausen, Aargau, Switzerland (1840–1860)

### Jurisdictional Context
Hausen (historically 'Hausen bei Brugg') is a municipality in Canton Aargau, Switzerland, near the town of Brugg. Aargau joined the Swiss Confederation as a new canton in 1803. Genealogical records are kept at the local (municipal) and cantonal level — there is no national centralization.

### Civil Registration
Switzerland did not begin civil registration (government vital records) until **1875**. For a birth ca. 25 Jan 1847, **only church records apply**.

### Church Records — Primary Record Type
Hausen is an overwhelmingly **Reformed** (Swiss Reformed / Protestant) parish; it became Reformed during the 1520s-1530s. Catholic records are not expected for this municipality.

**FamilySearch digitized Hausen volume:**
- imageGroupNumber **008119345_010_M99W-MXT** (164 images)
- Coverage: Baptisms (Taufen) 1850–1885; Marriages 1850–1885; Deaths 1850–1899
- recordSearchablePercent: **100%** (fully name-indexed)
- Language: German and Latin
- ⚠️ Starts 1850 — does NOT cover a January 1847 baptism.

**Broader FamilySearch Switzerland collections (1840-1860 window):**
| Collection | ID | Records | Access |
|---|---|---|---|
| Switzerland, Catholic and Reformed Church Records, 1418-1996 | 4138674 | 19.7M records / 2M images | Indexed + images |
| Switzerland, Baptisms, 1491-1940 | 1520585 | 776K records | Index only |
| Switzerland, Marriages, 1532-1910 | 1520589 | 211K records | Index only |
| Switzerland, Burials, 1613-1875 | 1520590 | 135K records | Index only |
| Switzerland, Church Records, 1277-1992 | 1640373 | 517K images | Browse-only |
| Switzerland, Church Book Extracts, 1550-1875 | 1790933 | 15K images | Browse-only |

### Physical Holdings
- **Aargau State Archives** (microfilm of most parish registers): https://www.ag.ch/de/verwaltung/bks/kultur/kulturpflege/bibliothek-archiv/staatsarchiv
- **Hausen municipal archive**: original records
- Parish record inventory for Aargau: https://www.ag.ch/media/kanton_aargau/bks/dokumente_1/kultur/staatsarchiv/BKSSTAR_Verzeichnis-KI.pdf

### External Resources
- Ancestry: Switzerland Select Baptisms (col. 60170), Switzerland Select Marriages (col. 60174)
- MyHeritage: Switzerland Baptisms 1491-1940
- Swiss Genealogy on the Internet: http://kunden.eye.ch/swissgen/
- GHGRB Billeter Sammlung (compiled Swiss genealogies): https://www.ghgrb.ch/index.php/de/forschungshilfen/billeter

### Research Strategy for ca. 1847 Birth
1. Search col. 4138674 with surname 'Widmer', birthYear ~1847, place Hausen/Aargau — primary indexed collection
2. Search col. 1520585 (Switzerland Baptisms) — surname 'Widmer', broad date range
3. If no result: search father Hans Ulrich Widmer in same collections to confirm which parish covered Hausen
4. If FamilySearch negative: Aargau State Archives microfilm at a FamilySearch center
